_note: Chelsea Clinton's own words only, each checked against the page in 'url' on 2026-10-23. Used for her Empowerment Emcee lines.

quotes.text: So, if anyone ever tells you no, if anyone says your voice isn't important or your dreams are too big, remember these women.
quotes.source: She Persisted (Philomel, 2017)

quotes.text: They persisted and so should you.
quotes.source: She Persisted (Philomel, 2017), closing line

quotes.text: everyone who's ever wanted to speak up but has been told to quiet down … everyone who's ever been made to feel less than.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton statement announcing She Persisted (2017)

quotes.text: In her refusal to get up, she persisted in taking a stand for what's right.
quotes.source: She Persisted (2017), Claudette Colvin

quotes.text: Sometimes, something that might seem small like a dress code policy is actually one of the ceilings
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, MTV interview

quotes.text: Of course I'm a feminist.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton (quoted in Bustle)

quotes.text: Which, of course, is so outlandish — I should be OK in being expected to be treated with respect
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton (quoted in Bustle)

quotes.text: I'm here as a proud American.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: A proud democrat.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: A proud mother.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: And tonight in particular, a very, very proud daughter.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: My parents cared about my thought.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: And I always, always, knew how deeply they loved me.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: That feeling of being valued and loved, that's what my mom wants for every child.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: How does she do it?
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: How does she keep going?
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: Amid the sound and the fury of politics.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: It's because she never ever forgets who she's fighting for.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: I hope That my children will someday be as proud of me as I am of my mom.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: I am so grateful to be her daughter.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: She makes me proud every single day.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: And mom, grandma would be so, so proud of you tonight.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: I know with all my heart that my mother will make us proud as our next president.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)

quotes.text: This is the story of my mother, Hillary Clinton.
quotes.source: Chelsea Clinton, 2016 Democratic National Convention speech, July 28 2016 (TIME transcript)
